verdict.rationale: Inngest's docs show cron-scheduled functions with timezone support, created via createFunction(). Scheduled jobs are a core use case, and a community user confirms it solved their scheduling needs. Concurrency limits exist and could indirectly prevent overlapping runs, but no cron overlap policy is documented. The run-level pausing shown (step.waitForEvent) is not schedule pause/resume. Missing for 10: explicit cron overlap policies, pausing/resuming schedules, visibility into upcoming scheduled runs, and independent hands-on corroboration of cron behavior.
